result.title: BEV3SR: Evidence-Aware 3D Spatial Reasoning from Video
result.summary: 3D spatial reasoning from video remains challenging for VLMs because videos provide sequential, view-local observations rather than persistent metric scene records. Many questions must be answered in a query-specified perspective rather than the observed camera viewpoint, and prompting with a fixed set of RGB views may miss sparse or occluded visual cues. To address these gaps, we introduce BEV3SR, a training-free and backbone-agnostic framework for RGB-D videos with camera parameters. BEV3SR turns video observations into queryable metric bird's-eye-view (BEV) scene memory and formalizes each query into an evidence-aware spatial task. The Spatial Task Formalizer specifies the query's reference frame, spatial constraints, objective, and evidence requirement. The evidence requirement determines the appropriate reasoning pathway. A query treated as requiring geometric evidence is handled by the Geometric Reasoner, which deterministically computes the answer using the metric BEV records in the query-specified reference frame. Otherwise, a query treated as requiring visual evidence is passed to the Visual Evidence Aligner, which uses BEV-indexed object records and their associated supporting views to retrieve object-consistent and scene-context RGB frames for VLM grounding. Within a standard 16-frame budget, BEV3SR consistently improves different VLM backbones across multiple 3D scene QA benchmarks, delivering large gains on spatially intensive questions and significant improvements on open-ended scene QA. These results demonstrate that BEV3SR offers an effective, efficient, and interpretable framework for explicit 3D spatial reasoning from video.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BEV3SR，一个 training-free、backbone-agnostic 框架：将 RGB-D 视频与相机参数转为可查询的度量 BEV 场景记忆，并把每个查询形式化为含参考系、空间约束、目标与证据需求的空间任务；需要几何证据的查询由几何推理器确定性求解，其余则按 BEV 索引检索对象一致的支持视图交给 VLM grounding，在多个 3D 场景 QA 基准上提升不同 VLM 骨干。
AI.relevance_reason: 核心在「证据需求决定推理路径」与「按 BEV 索引筛选支持视图」两点，与视觉证据筛选、证据获取和计算分配的研究兴趣直接相关；但其状态是显式度量记忆而非 latent，可供核查的是证据路由与视图选取策略，以及固定 16 帧预算下的收益—成本权衡能否迁移到 LVR。
